meta.name: antinet-four-color-cards
meta.description: 财务和投资分析师、律师助理与法律助手在撰写金融研报或分析法律文档时，必用此技能！基于解析文档一键生成事实蓝卡、解释绿卡、风险黄卡与行动红卡。自动完成深度剖析与风险排查，产出100%可溯源的结构化四色报告，让复杂分析高效且严谨。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 解析文档,生成四色分析卡,让复杂金融与法律分析高效严谨
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要快速梳理金融研报或法律文档中的事实与风险
copy.tagline_en: Turn complex documents into structured four-color analysis reports for finance and law.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to break down financial reports or legal documents into key facts and risks.

howto.what: 把解析好的结构化文档转成四张卡片:蓝卡记事实并附来源片段,绿卡做解释,黄卡列风险与过度声明,红卡给下一步建议。每张卡片都带来源与生成方式,便于溯源。
howto.when: 当你把解析后的结构化文档交给它、要求生成四色卡片时接管;金融研报或法律文档分析场景常用。

howto.what_en: Turns a parsed structured document into four cards: blue for facts with source snippets, green for explanation, yellow for risks and overclaims, red for next-step actions. Each card carries its source and generation method for traceability.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you hand it a parsed structured document and ask for four-color cards; commonly used for financial research or legal document analysis.

say_en.text: Generate four-color cards from this document
say_en.note: Outputs blue, green, yellow and red cards

say_en.text: Run --stage extract to pull out fact blue cards
Make risk yellow cards and action red cards for this report
say_en.note: Yellow gets reviewed, red gets strategy input
